name: upstream/negative-padding-dropped
description: Tailwind drops `-p-4`, `-pt-2`, etc. because the `padding` plugin is registered without `supportsNegativeValues: true` (see `corePlugins.js`: `padding: createUtilityPlugin('padding', […])` vs `margin: createUtilityPlugin('margin', […], { supportsNegativeValues: true })`). The expected output here is empty — both Galeforce and the oracle should produce no rules.
